units.state: wheel speed -100..100 (+ forward), arm/gripper absolute angle, degrees (+ down / + open)
units.target: controller target: wheel speeds; arm/gripper target angles, degrees
units.hat: Build HAT calls: wheel speeds running; arm/gripper run_for_degrees degrees this frame
units.buttons: [dpad_x, dpad_y, X, A, B, Y]: -1/0/1 D-pad (+ right / + up), 1 = pressed this frame
units.wheels: angle: state/target left/right are degrees turned since the episode's first frame (+ forward, not wrapped)
